answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions a fixed number of identity slots, so entry is priced by open bidding, not a flat fee. A glacier-slow floor price rises with demand, and a hollow shell account bids at the same price as everyone else. Bids are public, and the prism of published bids splits entrants into transparent bands, so identical bids are flagged. Forging 500 identities at 40 POA each costs 20,000 POA; an honest agent pays once.
